messages.text:
Hi Sarah,

Will it for sure ship on Nov 30th if I keep the order?
I was looking for something a bit quicker.

Thanks
Tim S. from my iPhone

Hi Tim,

Your Harlo H15 Dual ships November 30. That's the date on your order and it hasn't changed. I can't honestly promise it "for sure" on a pre-order, but it's the date we're working to. Your unit is already allocated to you, and tracking is emailed the moment it ships.

If you want something sooner, here are two in-stock units that ship within 2 business days to (address hidden). The Hammer Miner Thor P2 (10 TH/s Bitcoin) is $349. If you'd go with it, the $450 difference comes back to you as store credit. The Hammer DC06 (330 MH/s, Dogecoin) is $379.99 and sold as final sale. That leaves $419.01 as store credit. Either swap keeps your same order number.

You can also turn the full $839 you paid into store credit and use it on anything we stock.

Just reply with the one you'd like and I'll set it up.

Kind regards,
Sarah, HeliumDeploy Support

That fine. I’ll just keep my fingers crossed and hope it ships on the 30th.
Sorry for the bother.
Thanks,
Tim D. you guys plan on getting anymore Nexus S1 and L1’s at all anytime soon?
Thanks,
Tim S. from my iPhone

Hi Tim,

No bother at all. Your H15 Dual stays as it is, set to ship November 30, and you'll get tracking by email as soon as it goes out.

On the Nexus units, the S1 and the L1 are both off sale right now, and we don't have a confirmed date for new stock. I'd rather not guess at one. If they come back, they'll show up on the store as available again.

Kind regards,
Sarah, HeliumDeploy Support
